task.question: Return the tickers of the top 3 instruments by average daily closing price over the whole database, in descending order of that average.

result.question: Return the tickers of the top 3 instruments by average daily closing price over the whole database, in descending order of that average.
result.cited_sql: SELECT i.ticker, AVG(p.close) as avg_close FROM prices p JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.instrument_id GROUP BY p.instrument_id, i.ticker ORDER BY avg_close DESC LIMIT 3
